KXFED.rule: If the upper bound of the target federal funds rate published on the Federal Reserve's official website is greater than 5.25% following the Federal Reserve's Oct 28, 2026 meeting, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXFED.rule2: This market will expire the first 2:05 PM ET following the release of a Federal Reserve statement for their Oct 28, 2026 meeting or one week following the last day of that meeting.

KXFEDDECISION.rule: If the Federal Reserve does a Hike of   25bps on October 28, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXFEDDECISION.rule2:
The outcomes are mutually exclusive: at most one can resolve to Yes. For example, a 50-basis-point hike resolves “Hike   25 bps” to Yes and “Hike 25 bps” to No.

If the scheduled FOMC meeting is canceled and does not occur on its scheduled date, “Fed maintains rate” resolves to Yes and all other out

KXRATECUTCOUNT.rule: If the Fed cuts exactly 9 times before 2026, the market resolves to Yes.
KXRATECUTCOUNT.rule2: To be clear, 25bp of cuts is equal to one cut (so 25bp cut is 1, 50bp cut is 2, 75bp cut is 3, and so on). Note: this detail has been included in past iterations including the previous iteration titled, "Number of rate cuts in 2024?"

KXEFFR.rule: If the first published Effective Federal Funds Rate (EFFR) value for September 30, 2026 is above 4.00%, then the market resolves to Yes.

KXSOFR.rule: If the Secured Overnight Financing Rate strictly exceeds 0.05% on September 25, 2021, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXSOFR.rule2: Please see SOFR in the rulebook for more details.

KXSOFRD.rule: If the Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR) for November 17, 2026 is at least 3.95%, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXSOFRD.rule2: The Underlying is the initially reported SOFR for November 17, 2026 in the table named “Secured Overnight Financing Rate Data” in the column labeled “Rate (%)”. Later revisions will not be accounted for in determining the Expiration Value.

KX3MTBILL.rule: If U.S. Treasury Daily Yield Curve Rate (3 Mo) for June 30, 2026 (end of Q2 2026) is above 4.00%, then the market resolves to Yes.

KXINXMAXMM.rule: If the value of the S&P 500 index value starting Jun 1, 2026 and ending on Jun 30, 2026 is above 7750, then the market resolves to Yes.

KXINXWUD.rule: If the end-of-day price of the S&P 500 on June 05, 2026 is above 7580.06, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXINXWUD.rule2: The target value is the end-of-day/closing price of the prior week's close.

KXNASDAQWUD.rule: If the end-of-day price of the NASDAQ-100 on June 05, 2026 is above 30333.18, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXNASDAQWUD.rule2: The target value is the end-of-day/closing price of the prior week's close.

KXFRM.rule2: The contract will expire at the sooner of the first 12:05 PM following the release of the data for February 22, 2024, or February 29, 2024. The Last Trading Time will always be 11:55 AM ET on February 22, 2024.

KX10Y2Y.rule: If the daily 10-Year Treasury Constant Maturity minus the 2-year Treasury Constant Maturity according to the Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED) series, measured in percent and not seasonally adjusted, between Issuance and <date>, is above 0%, then the market resolves to Yes.
KX10Y2Y.rule2: Please note that intraday changes will not be reflected in the Underlying, as FRED only posts a single value per day.
